rules.name: Completed reports have an output object
rules.query: SELECT id::text AS subject_id, CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN output_key IS NULL ELSE false END AS violated, jsonb_build_object('status', status, 'outputKey', output_key) AS evidence FROM public.rhinoq_example_reports WHERE updated_at >= $1 AND (($4::text = '' AND id::text > $2) OR id::text = $4) ORDER BY id::text LIMIT $3
